annotations.title: Find brands to pitch for UGC

description: Lists brands in a niche from Newcollab's brand directory for UGC creators looking for brands to pitch for paid UGC or gifted collabs, ordered by signals: an open paid UGC brief on Newcollab, creator-style ads, ads seen running in the last 30 days, and confirmed work with creators. Returns up to 8 brands with the reasons, a public brand page link, and a link to Newcollab's creator signup.

country.description: Two-letter country the creator lives in, e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'CA', 'AU'.
